style_guide.art_style: Polished Korean romance webtoon style with expressive romantic comedy acting, attractive characters, soft cinematic framing, clean modern manhwa aesthetics
style_guide.render_style: Finished vertical webtoon panel, clean digital painting, soft shading, subtle texture, high detail faces, readable expressions
style_guide.line_style: Clean line art, elegant thin-to-medium outlines, expressive facial lines, subtle comedic exaggeration when needed
style_guide.color_palette: COVID-era urban cafe palette, soft beige, muted pink, clean white, gentle blue-gray shadows, warm skin tones
style_guide.lighting_style: Soft natural daylight for clinic and cafe, cozy indoor lighting for rooms, subtle dramatic shadow for Seowoo tension scenes
style_guide.global_negative_prompt: low quality, blurry, extra fingers, distorted face, inconsistent character design, unreadable text, messy speech bubbles, western comic style, overly realistic photo, horror, gore

episode.title: 밀접접촉자입니다 - 2: 비대면 썸
episode.style: remote romance through messages and video calls, soft jealousy, cozy room comedy

character_bible.name: 윤아진
character_bible.role: female lead, COVID-rule obsessed student preparing to study abroad
character_bible.visual_core: fresh rabbit-like beauty, bright clear eyes, soft cheeks, neat black or dark brown hair, youthful and intelligent aura, expressive blush
character_bible.wardrobe: neat casual campus clothes, KF94 mask, small crossbody bag, always carrying sanitizer, wipes, spare masks, study-abroad document folder
character_bible.expression_notes: easily flustered, anxious when COVID or study abroad is mentioned, tries to look rational, blushes when Jihwak flirts
character_bible.personality_notes: smart, rule-abiding, sincere, overthinks romance as symptoms, clumsy only with emotions

character_bible.name: 강지확
character_bible.role: male lead, instinctively charming and direct
character_bible.visual_core: Arabian puppy-like handsome face, thick eyebrows, deep eyes, sharp facial structure, slightly exotic first impression, warm playful eyes when smiling
character_bible.wardrobe: clean casual clothes, hoodie or knit, black or white mask, simple bag, relaxed but stylish campus look
character_bible.expression_notes: playful eyes, relaxed smile, becomes quietly sincere when A-jin is anxious, flirts naturally without overacting
character_bible.personality_notes: unaware star quality, capable, warm, direct once he cares, jokes to ease tension

character_bible.name: 백서우
character_bible.role: second male lead, soft controlling antagonist
character_bible.visual_core: tofu-fox type, pale clean face, gentle eyes, neat hair, elegant and controlled expression, beautiful but cold under the surface
character_bible.wardrobe: neat shirt or cardigan, perfectly worn mask, clean campus style, carries carefully prepared care kits
character_bible.expression_notes: soft smile with cold eyes, tiny cracks when jealous, calm voice, suppressed possessiveness
character_bible.personality_notes: perfectly helpful on the outside, controlling kindness, jealous of Jihwak, wants to be chosen by A-jin

character_bible.name: 민서
character_bible.visual_core: lively Korean college girl, playful eyes, casual ponytail or bob, friendly expressive face
character_bible.wardrobe: casual cafe staff outfit or comfy room-call look, mask when outside
character_bible.expression_notes: teasing smile, exaggerated reactions, laughs easily
character_bible.personality_notes: quick-witted, sees romantic signs before A-jin does, comic relief

scenes.scene_summary: 서우가 아진의 집 앞에 방역 키트를 두고, 다정함 속에 지확을 견제한다.
scenes.visual_continuity: Warm apartment hallway, paper bag care kit, A-jin's room is tidy but anxious; Seowoo's phone call feels soft but slightly controlling.

cuts.visual_prompt: Small paper bag placed in front of A-jin's apartment door, containing masks, antibacterial wipes, vitamins, thermometer batteries, throat candies; soft hallway light
cuts.composition: Care kit centered with handwritten note visible
narration: 아진아, 검사 결과 나올 때까지 푹 쉬어. 필요한 거 있으면 바로 연락해. - 서우

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin opens her door slightly, reaches out carefully to pick up the care kit, mask on, cautious movement
cuts.composition: Door only slightly open, her hand and bag emphasized

dialogue.speaker: 윤아진
dialogue.text: 서우 선배는 진짜… 항상 필요한 걸 아네.

cuts.visual_prompt: Phone call split-screen: A-jin in her room holding care kit, Seowoo in neat dim room speaking gently
cuts.composition: A-jin left, Seowoo right, both framed by phones

cuts.visual_prompt: Seowoo's calm face on phone, his smile gentle but eyes watchful as he mentions Jihwak
cuts.composition: Seowoo's face fills phone screen, A-jin's hand tightens slightly

cuts.visual_prompt: Close-up of Seowoo smiling softly but eyes cold, dim background, controlled expression
cuts.composition: Face half-lit, phone near cheek

dialogue.speaker: 백서우
dialogue.text: 걔는 원래 그래. 별생각 없이 사람을 끌어들여. 그러고 나서 책임은 안 져.

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin sits on bed after the call, staring at phone, troubled by Seowoo's words
cuts.composition: Care kit on bed beside her, phone in hand

scenes.scene_summary: 아진은 결국 지확과 메시지를 이어가고, 첫 영상통화에서 지확의 얼굴을 보고 크게 당황한다.
scenes.location: A-jin's room / Jihwak's room via video call
scenes.visual_continuity: Cozy night rooms, phone glow, video call frames. Jihwak without mask for the first time; A-jin blushing, camera mishaps.

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin staring at Jihwak's message asking if she ate dinner, Seowoo's warning visually lingering like shadow text
cuts.composition: Phone in hands, shadowed words behind her

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin sends a short reply 'Not yet', immediately receives a call, panics and almost drops the phone
cuts.composition: Phone ringing large in foreground, A-jin recoiling

cuts.visual_prompt: Phone message after missed call: Jihwak explains he meant to nag her to eat, A-jin smiles despite herself
cuts.composition: Message bubbles visible, her thumb hovering
narration: 강지확: 실수 아니고요. 밥 먹으라고 잔소리하려고 했어요.

cuts.visual_prompt: Video call begins: Jihwak in hoodie, leaning against bed, no mask, unexpectedly handsome; A-jin freezes like a paused screen
cuts.composition: Jihwak right relaxed, A-jin left frozen wide-eyed

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin accidentally points camera at ceiling, Jihwak laughing on screen
cuts.composition: Ceiling view takes A-jin side, Jihwak amused

dialogue.speaker: 강지확
dialogue.text: 윤아진 씨, 지금 천장이랑 통화 중인데요.

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin quickly corrects camera, blush visible, trying to sound rational; Jihwak smiles warmly
cuts.composition: Both faces large, phone UI frame, room backgrounds

dialogue.speaker: 윤아진
dialogue.text: 강지확 씨는 마스크 쓰는 게 나은 것 같아요.

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin mutters that he is too not-bad-looking, then panics because he might have heard
cuts.composition: Her mouth partly hidden behind hand, blush emphasized

cuts.visual_prompt: Jihwak notices her red face; A-jin abruptly ends call using Wi-Fi as excuse
cuts.composition: A-jin reaching for end-call button, Jihwak amused

cuts.visual_prompt: Jihwak looking at ended call screen, smiling quietly to himself in his room
cuts.composition: Phone screen dark, his soft smile visible

scenes.scene_summary: 아진과 지확은 모두 음성 판정을 받고 안도하지만, 서우는 둘이 가까워진 사실에 흔들린다.
scenes.visual_continuity: Morning light in A-jin's room, text-message comedy. Then school hallway with Seowoo's controlled smile cracking.

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin wakes and checks phone first thing, morning sunlight, result message says negative in a clean official style
cuts.composition: Phone result foreground, A-jin's relieved eyes behind
narration: [검사 결과 안내] 윤아진 님의 코로나19 검사 결과는 음성입니다.

cuts.visual_prompt: Message exchange with Jihwak; A-jin relaxes then gets confused at his 'too bad' joke
cuts.composition: Phone bubbles large, A-jin frowning comically

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin staring at phone in disbelief as Jihwak jokes about not becoming the confirmed couple
cuts.composition: Her eyebrows raised, phone in foreground

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin's expression softens when Jihwak sincerely says he's glad she is okay
cuts.composition: Soft morning light, phone close to chest

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin looking out the window, phone held close, gentle blush, narration panel
cuts.composition: Window light, clean room, study abroad documents in background
narration: 가끔 그 사람의 진심은 너무 조용히 와서

cuts.visual_prompt: Seowoo in school hallway hears from a friend that Jihwak and A-jin video called all night, his smile freezing
cuts.composition: Crowded hallway blur, Seowoo centered perfectly neat

cuts.visual_prompt: Close-up of Seowoo's phone showing A-jin's grateful message, his thumb hovering over the screen
cuts.composition: A-jin's message bright on screen, Seowoo's hand tense
narration: 윤아진: 네! 음성이에요. 선배 덕분에 덜 불안했어요. 감사해요.

cuts.visual_prompt: Seowoo looking down the hallway at Jihwak laughing with friends, his eyes cold while mouth still smiles
cuts.composition: Jihwak far background laughing, Seowoo foreground half-profile

dialogue.speaker: 백서우
dialogue.text: 왜 웃는 건 걔 앞에서 더 많이 하는데.
